hints.title: Grow and shrink
hints.body: Expand the right edge until the window covers the target, then shrink the left edge as far as possible.

hints.title: Track requirements
hints.body: Keep required counts and a count of how many distinct letters are satisfied.

hints.title: Record the best
hints.body: After each shrink step, compare the window length with the best found so far.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
need = counts of target
window = counts in the current range
formed = number of letters whose window count meets need
left = 0
for right in range(len(source)):
    add source[right] to window, update formed
    while formed == required:
        update best window
        remove source[left] from window, update formed
        left += 1
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
